meaning: the station has an operator, who works each tote presented there: a person, a robot arm or an induction conveyor alike, each stage of its sequence stated in seconds of simtime

schema.title: operator
schema.description: the station has an operator, who works each tote presented there: a person, a robot arm or an induction conveyor alike, each stage of its sequence stated in seconds of simtime
schema.$comment: Written for world-proto's registry from dessim's `OperatorComponent` (libs/dessim/src/worldmap/stations.rs on wip/cencora-fences-curtains at 063d32210). Every stage is stated, zero for a stage the operator lacks, because a missing figure is not a zero; only the regrip may go unstated. Open to fields a newer writer adds, as the vocabulary's other definitions are; dessim's reader refuses a field it does not know.

entry_secs.description: How long a tote's robot pauses, in simtime, before it enters its cell.

scan_secs.description: From the end of that pause until the tote is scanned.

plan_secs.description: How long the station takes to plan each tote after its scan.

pick_secs.description: From the operator reaching the tote until the unit is out of it. Zero only at a put station, whose robot pulls out as its case lands.

cycle_secs.description: From the operator reaching a tote until it may reach the next, for a case that needs no regrip; no shorter than the pick.

regrip.description: The cases the operator puts down and grips again after its pick, at a pick station only.

secs.description: How much longer the cycle runs for such a case.

share.description: The share of the cases that need it.
